evidence.quote: Use deferred work when its waiting and workload benefits justify the extra queue, worker, status and duplicate-processing coordination.

evidence.quote: An accepted request does not mean the work is complete.

outcomes.reason: All six criteria supported: learner identifies API contract/implementation, client/database roles, optional persistence, routing/validation, identity versus permission and protected effects only after checks.

All six criteria supported: immediate completion, deferred acceptance, queue/worker, job/status notification, no automatic completion-time reduction, visible terminal failures and explicit idempotency/deduplication for uncertain retries.

sourceChecks.claim: Live MDN server-side introduction distinguishes presentation from request validation, computation and database use, supporting the API boundary rather than identifying it with storage.
Live OWASP REST Security requires endpoint access control and input validation and distinguishes 401 authentication from 403 authorization. This verifies known identity is insufficient permission.
Live Azure asynchronous request-reply solution returns 202 plus status location, queues work and later exposes completion; status model includes pending and failed.
Live Azure pattern discusses latency, client coordination, failure handling and idempotency. RFC 9110 9.2.2 followup verifies original work may have succeeded despite lost response.
Live Azure pattern conditions use on long processing and accepted later completion, validates before launching work and requires status/error lifecycle; this supports the response-first choice.
